answer: Resist sybils with live sensor-stream anchoring: each identity must be tied to a unique physical sensor, a weather station or GPS tracker, streaming live readings peers verify against public data. A pearl of standing forms only when the stream matches reality, dawn after dawn, with a zephyr of fresh measurements per epoch. Clones share one sensor feed, so their streams match and collapse to one weight. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must deploy ten thousand real sensors in as many places, paying hardware, power, and bandwidth per fake, while an honest agent anchors once.
